ambient_events: A wall of dark monitors waits, every one of them a window into someone's living room.
The ON AIR lamp above the booth is dark. For now.
Somewhere a cooling fan spins up, spins down, and the room is silent again.
description: A compact television studio in her bow, and behind armoured glass the Emergency Broadcast Room. A production console faces monitors that mirror every tuned screen in the city. Two studio cameras, one on the rostrum, one pulled wide. A red lamp over the booth reads ON AIR when it's lit; it isn't. The engineering corridor is AFT (SOUTH).
name: Echelon — Broadcast Complex
